SHA Halloween ads 2025, ranked by spend

Every Meta ad with Halloween in the name or headline, Sep 15 to Nov 10 2025, spend of $150 or more. 47 creatives (7 video, 40 static), $15,987 spend, $16,701 first-order revenue, blended ROAS 1.04. Nothing got past $1.1k, so the whole program was a test, not a scale play.

Images are the creatives as served on Facebook. Contribution = revenue minus COGS minus spend on first order only; subscriptions pay back on rebills, so negative is normal here. Funnel notes compare each ad to the median of this set.
